rawVariants.cite: International Telecommunication Union—Radiocommunication (ITU-R), Recommendation BT.2521-0, “Practical Examples of Actions to Realize Energy Aware Broadcasting,” International Telecommunication Union, Tech. Rep., 2023. About the authors Erik Reinhard is a distinguished scientist at InterDigital Cesson-Sévigné, France, since June 2019. Before that, he held the same position at Technicolor R&I Cesson-Sevigné, starting in July 2013 and before that he held various academic positions at universities and research institutes in Europe and North America. He was the founder and editor-in-chief of ACM Transactions on Applied Perception and authored books on high dynamic range (HDR) imaging, color imaging, computer graphics, and natural image statistics. He has published more than 100 papers and was a member of more than 50 program committees. He was a program co-chair of six conferences and workshops, including the Eurographics Symposium on Rendering 2011. He delivered keynotes at Eurographics 2010, the Computational Color Imaging Workshop 2011, the IS&T European Conference on Color in Graphics, Imaging, and Vision 2012, the IS&T Color Imaging Conference 2022, and the ACM/SIGGRAPH Conference on Visual Media Processing 2022. He is the co-chair of the Rapporteur Group on Energy Aware Broadcasting at ITU-R and co-lead of the Study Mission on Energy Aware Service Delivery and Consumption at DVB. Finally, he won a test of time award for his color transfer paper in IEEE Computer Graphics and Applications. A contribution received April 2023. Copyright © 2023 by SMPTE.
